segments.text:
V. 33.
He groaned—So He reſtrained his Tears. So He ſtopt them ſoon after, ver. 38. He troubled himſelf—An Expreſſion amazingly elegant, and full of the higheſt Propriety. For the Affections of Jeſus were not properly Paſſions, but voluntary Emotions, which were wholly in his own Power. And this tender Trouble which He now voluntarily ſuſtained, was full of the higheſt Order and Reaſon.
